popCulture.title: Theseus (Plutarch)
popCulture.creator: Plutarch
popCulture.description: Plutarch's Life of Theseus opens at Troezen: Pittheus the wise king, father of Aethra, who understands Aegeus' oracle and steers the night that begets Athens' hero.

popCulture.title: Theseus
popCulture.description: Pittheus is grandfather and early tutor of Theseus — the Troezenian sage who raises the boy until he can lift Aegeus' tokens from under the rock.

popCulture.title: Troezen
popCulture.description: Pittheus' city on the Argolid coast — the sanctuary-kingdom where Theseus is born and schooled before the road to Athens.

popCulture.title: Pittheus
popCulture.description: Son of Pelops, king of Troezen, father of Aethra — famed for wisdom and for hosting Aegeus on the night that fathers Theseus.
